_comment: LOCAL byte-baseline for packages/quay/src/primitives/*.mjs. quay is the canonical home of these four modules: they were originally copied from quay-fleet, that upstream is retired, and packages/quay/src/primitives/PROVENANCE.md keeps the copy's history as a read-only record — there is no external repo left to read and nothing here points at one. Read by plugin/scripts/primitives-drift-check.ts, which compares ONLY the files below against these sha256 values, entirely inside this repo. An in-place edit MUST re-record that file's sha256 here in the SAME commit: that is a deliberate re-baseline (state the reason in PROVENANCE.md and the commit message), whereas editing this file alone to silence the check is exactly the drift it exists to catch.
